reason: The default graph makes the sequence explicit, but long wraparound links and two crossings obscure the paired stellar lifecycles. The source uses two immediately legible loops and distinct celestial objects.
dsl_nastiness: Moderate to high. The semantic model remains easy to scan, but every stage receives a size and a pin, most edges receive explicit endpoint sides, and a palette entry is needed just to make the note legible. The two paths can be edited, but the final composition no longer adapts automatically.
residuals: No nebula/stellar illustration, glow, texture or scientifically recognizable silhouettes in native DSL.
No tapered circular flow bands or text along a path.
Object-bound labels replace separate exterior captions.
Manual sizes and pins mean later text changes require review.
Relative physical sizes are not preserved; the diagram must not be read as a size scale.
observed: Original, v0, v1 and v2 images visually inspected; final native CLI checks, geometry, SVG and PNG were executed.
predicted: Label-edit resilience is an unexecuted assessment; no edit-resilience experiment or pixel-error registration was performed.
